newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble firms in bullish trade, sought for arrears.
newsitem.headline: Rouble firms in bullish trade, sought for arrears.

text.p: The rouble firmed in active trading on Wednesday as banks maintained long positions in the hope of higher rates and dealers said more active payments of arrears by the state also boosted demand.
roubles/dollar Mar 12 midday Mar 12 early Mar 11 close
"Banks are having enough roubles but they are keeping them at the moment. Credit rates are likely to fall by the evening," an SBS-Agro Bank dealer said.
He added currently higher yields of the government securities could also attract funds.
United Investment Bank chief dealer Alexander Suchkov said the rouble shortage could be due to the paying of wage and pension arrears.
"Arrears payments could become more active after the government reshuffle. Besides, the central bank was buying roubles actively last week, possibly for the same reason," he said.
